chemistry-killer-05.topic: Advanced Stoichiometry in HCl-NaOH Neutralization Titration
chemistry-killer-05.goal: Analyze the principles of Advanced Stoichiometry in HCl-NaOH Neutralization Titration and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
chemistry-killer-05.material:
An ƙara 0.1 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ a hankali zuwa 50 mL na 0.2 M $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ kuma aka bincika jimillar adadin ions a maganin ruwa (mmol). Ba a ƙirga ruwa a matsayin ions ba kuma amsawar $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$ kaɗai ke faruwa.
Girman NaOH(aq) da aka ƙara (mL): 0 / 50 / 100
Jimillar adadin ions (mmol): 20 / 20 / 20
Lokacin da aka ƙara 150 mL na NaOH(aq), menene rabon adadin $\mathrm{Na^+ : Cl^- : OH^-}$ a gauraye, da (jimillar adadin ions bayan haɗawa) ÷ (jimillar adadin ions da ke cikin 50 mL na HCl(aq) da 150 mL na NaOH(aq) kafin haɗawa)? (Yi watsi da auto-ionization na ruwa.)
chemistry-killer-05.thinking.0: Advanced Stoichiometry in HCl-NaOH Neutralization Titration
chemistry-killer-05.s.s1.prompt:
An ƙara 0.1 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ a hankali zuwa 50 mL na 0.2 M $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ kuma aka bincika jimillar adadin ions a maganin ruwa (mmol). Ba a ƙirga ruwa a matsayin ions ba kuma amsawar $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$ kaɗai ke faruwa.
Girman NaOH(aq) da aka ƙara (mL): 0 / 50 / 100
Jimillar adadin ions (mmol): 20 / 20 / 20
Lokacin da aka ƙara 150 mL na NaOH(aq), menene rabon adadin $\mathrm{Na^+ : Cl^- : OH^-}$ a gauraye, da (jimillar adadin ions bayan haɗawa) ÷ (jimillar adadin ions da ke cikin 50 mL na HCl(aq) da 150 mL na NaOH(aq) kafin haɗawa)? (Yi watsi da auto-ionization na ruwa.)
chemistry-killer-05.s.s1.explain:
Mataki na 1: Fassarar tebur. 0 mL: H+ 10 + Cl- 10 = 20. 50 mL: H+ 5, Cl- 10, Na+ 5 = 20. 100 mL: Cl- 10, Na+ 10 = 20 (wurin neutralization). Har zuwa wurin neutralization, Na+ yana maye H+ 1:1, don haka jimillar adadin ions tana tsayayye.
Mataki na 2: 150 mL: daga NaOH ana samar da Na+ 15 mmol da OH- 15 mmol. H+ 10 mmol yana amsawa da OH- 10 mmol kuma ya ƙare, don haka OH- 5 mmol ya rage. Ions = Na+ 15, Cl- 10, OH- 5 → rabon adadi 3 : 2 : 1, jimilla 30 mmol.
Mataki na 3: Jimillar adadin ions kafin haɗawa = (10 + 10) + (15 + 15) = 50 mmol. Rabo = 30/50 = 3/5.
Amsa: 3 : 2 : 1, 3/5 (a). (Kuskure: OH- 15 maimakon 5 yana watsi da neutralization, 5/3 juyayyen rabo ne, 3/4 ƙima ce ta kuskuren ƙirga ions 40 kafin haɗawa)
chemistry-killer-05.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
